fullValidationReview.note: Full pass over the era with scripts/bulbapedia/sample-review.mjs swsh --all (seed 20260301, live TCGdex). 262 of the 274 flags were a transient TCGdex outage: every one of those relationships re-checked clean afterwards (S10A->swsh11 75/0, S-P->swshp 105/0, S-P->swsh12.5 29/0, S-P->swsh4.5 12/0, S-P->swsh8 9/0, S10A->swsh11tg 7/0, S10A->swsh12 11/0, S-P->swsh2 3/0, S-P->swsh3.5 3/0, S10P->swsh11 16/0, LOR:TG->S9a 1/0, S-P->smp 1/0), so the validator now re-asks once after a short wait before reporting a 404. The 12 real flags are source artifacts, not wrong pairings: nine SWSH-era special energies where Bulbapedia prints the abbreviated name ("Speed L Energy", "Horror P Energy", "Heat R Energy", "Powerful C Energy", "Hiding D Energy", "Stone F Energy", "Aromatic G Energy", "Wash W Energy", "Coating M Energy") against TCGdex's full name, "Basic Fighting Energy" for Fighting Energy, one kana typo (Pot Helmet なベメット for なべメット) and one HP difference (Bronzong S6H-092 110 vs 130). Card name, number and set all match, so the records stay. Note for later: the abbreviated energy names are what the marketplace queries use for those nine cards.
